required_behavior: While the command menu is open, the prefix key (Ctrl-]) alone closes it immediately (as the label promises); prefix prefix and Esc keep working.

After the prefix, the entire contiguous run of non-ASCII text in the same input burst (e.g. several Hangul syllables committed at once, possibly split across reads) is dropped with a single hint; none of it reaches a pane; the next ASCII byte/command after the run is handled normally.
acceptance: red->green own tests for the multi-syllable burst (tests/ui/test_product_model.py)
rules: venv python, short TMPDIR; no graphify update, commits, pkill; zero residue.
result_format: checks table first, status, changed paths + sha256, residue. Korean, concise.
